title: Align MCP tools with OpenAPI spec and add entity types
description: Fix mismatches between current operations and the Moneybird OpenAPI spec. Remove unsupported pagination from financial_accounts. Pass filter/query params to API instead of client-side filtering. Add estimates, recurring_sales_invoices, ledger_accounts to moneybird_list and moneybird_get.
notes:
Outcome (2026-03-01 14:50 CET):

**Summary:**
- Aligned moneybird_list with OpenAPI spec: filter/query/page/per_page now passed as query params to API (server-side filtering)
- Fixed financial_accounts and ledger_accounts: pagination correctly disabled (spec says unsupported)
- Added entity types: estimates, recurring_sales_invoices, ledger_accounts
- Expanded moneybird_get from 2 to 8 entity types
- Removed special-casing for contacts/invoices, removed unused imports (zod, listContacts, type imports)
- Simplified to use generic param passing for all entities

**Files Modified:**
- src/index.ts (aligned with OpenAPI spec, expanded entities)
- src/common/version.ts (bumped to 0.7.1)

**Issues Encountered:**
- None
close_reason: Aligned tools with OpenAPI spec, added 3 entity types, fixed pagination/filter handling

title: Fix: reduce MCP server token footprint from 25k tokens
description: GitHub issue #3: The MCP server tool schemas consume ~25k tokens in the context window. Need to consolidate 10 tools into fewer tools, trim descriptions, remove useless moneybird_assistant tool/prompt, and clean up unnecessary boilerplate. Also integrate openapi.yml as reference for the generic request tool.
notes:
Outcome (2026-03-01 14:29 CET):

**Summary:**
- Consolidated 10 MCP tools into 3 (moneybird_list, moneybird_get, moneybird_request)
- Reduced src/index.ts from 620 to 237 lines (62% reduction)
- Removed: moneybird_assistant tool, prompts handler, setupStdioDebugger, progressUpdates, chunkResponse, updateHealthMetrics helpers
- Tool schema JSON reduced by 52% (2954 -> 1404 chars), plus 7 fewer tools means much less per-tool framing overhead
- Integrated OpenAPI spec paths into moneybird_request description for discoverability
- Bumped version to 0.7.0 (breaking: tool names changed)

**Files Modified:**
- src/index.ts (major rewrite: consolidated tools, removed boilerplate)
- src/common/version.ts (bumped to 0.7.0)

**Issues Encountered:**
- None

**Next Steps:**
- [ ] Update README to document new tool names
- [ ] Consider adding openapi.yml to .gitignore (2MB reference file)

**References:**
- GitHub issue: #3
close_reason: Consolidated 10 tools to 3, reduced context footprint by 52%+ schema chars and 7 fewer tools
